name: Too Many Streams
description: Dispatcharr v0.29-compatible fallback stream shown when provider connection capacity is exhausted.
author: JamesWRC and contributors

fields.label: Stream Title
fields.placeholder: The title displayed on the 'Too Many Streams' image.
fields.help_text: The title displayed on the 'Too Many Streams' image.

fields.label: Stream Description
fields.default: While this channel is not currently available, here are some other channels you can watch.
fields.placeholder: The description displayed on the 'Too Many Streams' image.
fields.help_text: The description displayed on the 'Too Many Streams' image.

fields.label: Number of channel columns
fields.placeholder: The number of columns of channels to display on the 'Too Many Streams' image.
fields.help_text: The number of columns of channels to display on the 'Too Many Streams' image.

fields.label: Static Image Path
fields.placeholder: Path to a static image to use instead of the dynamic image.
fields.help_text: Path to a static image to use instead of the dynamic image.

fields.label: Video Encoder
fields.help_text: FFmpeg encoder (e.g., libx264, h264_nvenc, h264_qsv, h264_omx, h264_videotoolbox). Use libx264 if unsure.

fields.label: Background Color
fields.help_text: Hex code for the main background.

fields.label: Card Background Color
fields.help_text: Hex code for the channel card background.

fields.label: Card Border Color
fields.help_text: Hex code for the card border.

fields.label: Text Color
fields.help_text: Hex code for the main text.

fields.label: Accent Color
fields.help_text: Hex code for accents (e.g., channel number pill).

fields.label: Accent Text Color
fields.help_text: Hex code for text inside accent pills.

actions.label: Add TooManyStreams source to all channels
actions.description: Adds the TooManyStreams custom source at the bottom of every channel.

actions.label: Remove TooManyStreams source from all channels
actions.description: Removes the TooManyStreams custom source assignment from every channel.

actions.label: Clean legacy assignments
actions.description: Removes obsolete channel-stream links created by versions earlier than 4.0.

actions.label: Save Plugin Config
actions.description: Saves the current plugin configuration to persistent storage.

actions.label: Search for Persistent Config
actions.description: Manually searches for and reloads the persistent configuration file from disk.
